snippet.title: Crime Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Crime Simulator - Crime Begins on June 17, 2025 (Steam): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2528880/Crime_Simulator/

👮 You’re out of jail… but freedom comes at a price. In Crime Simulator, you’ve got a debt to pay and time’s running out. Break into houses, steal valuables, and pull off dangerous jobs solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op 👥. 

Use stealth, gadgets, or brute force - whatever gets the job done. From high-tech mansions to shady alleys, each heist is a race against the clock ⏰. Upgrade your hideout, master 15+ skills, and become the ultimate criminal mastermind. Don’t just play the game. Own it. 🔓

#COOP #CrimeSimulator #HeistGame #StealthAction #CoopGame #PCGaming #SimulatorGame #crimegames  #HeistWithFriends
